label: Text 1
transcript: Eli's class read a short text about food inequality in their own town. The school cafeteria is free for students who qualify. The qualification is invisible — the cards look the same. Mr. Yilmaz pointed out that the cards were redesigned three years ago precisely so they would all look the same. "That's a small thing," Naima said. Mr. Yilmaz nodded. "Small things do most of the work."
